controls.method: Unchanged original greedy clustering block, find_duplicates and sort_dup_groups functions; minimal synthetic FileEntry, injected hash callback; rustc 1.98.1. No image/NAS/cache/network/deletion execution.

findings: Original greedy radius-1 clustering hashes [0,1,3] yields pair [0,1]; order [1,0,3] yields all three. This is seed-star policy, not connected-component/all-pairs grouping.

Original largest-first sorting can replace seed hash1 by larger hash0 while hash3 remains in group at distance2, outside threshold1. This proves loss of representative-neighbor invariant after keeper sorting, not actual deletion outcome.
Original exact grouping trusts callback digest: injected same digest groups both entries. No claim of real SHA256 collision; no byte-confirmation call in inspected function.
A failing hash increments errors while healthy same-size pair remains grouped.
Local discovery skips empty files, extension-filters by default and discards WalkDir errors using filter_map(ok); no runtime discovery control executed yet.
Cache key uses path, size and second-resolution modification time, no algorithm/model revision or high-resolution freshness; consumer cache lifecycle still incomplete review.
